name: Huffman-shaped Wavelet Matrix
definition: A data structure used to compress and provide random access to a stream of node operations (T) in segmentation volume bricks. It maps symbols from an alphabet Σ to bit patterns using bit-wise negated Canonical Huffman Codes (CHC), stored in a level-wise concatenated bit vector (W) acting as a wavelet matrix.
summary: The Huffman-shaped Wavelet Matrix is a compressed index enabling random access to volume brick operations by exploiting Canonical Huffman Codes to eliminate branching and interval tracking.
